text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's Air Groove. Let me state this once 
more—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—To embody the 'ideal' of every Umamusume 
and serve as everyone's guiding light. 
That is the realm I must strive for as the 
'Empress.'”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The path is steep, and there is no time to 
idle. Therefore, as my Trainer, do not let 
your guard down for a moment and follow me 
closely.

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
